lines:
sequenceDiagram
autonumber
actor User
participant View as Feature View
participant Gateway as Projection Gateway
participant IPC as Tauri IPC
participant Core as Trusted Core
Gateway->>IPC: subscribe(afterSequence)
IPC->>Core: ProjectionQuery(scope, afterSequence)
Core-->>Gateway: Snapshot(throughSequence N, reducerVersion, stateHash)
Gateway->>Gateway: Hydrate pure projections and cursor N
Gateway-->>View: Immutable projection generation
Core-->>Gateway: Committed SpanStarted sequence N plus 1
Gateway->>Gateway: Validate contiguous and create span
Gateway-->>View: Render running activity
loop Committed incremental content
 Core-->>Gateway: SpanContentDelta next sequence
 Gateway->>Gateway: Append by spanId and channel
 Gateway-->>View: Reactive content update
end
Core-->>Gateway: Committed span terminal next sequence
Gateway->>Gateway: Set output or error and terminal state
Gateway-->>View: Final activity state
User->>View: Start, enqueue, save, or activate repair
View->>Gateway: UiCommand(commandId,targetVersion,payload)
Gateway-->>View: Pending, not domain success
Gateway->>Core: Typed command via IPC
alt Rejected before commit
 Core-->>Gateway: CommandRejected
 Gateway-->>View: Preserve draft and show rejection
else Accepted
 Core-->>Gateway: CommandReceipt accepted
 Note over Gateway,View: Pending until committed event
 Core-->>Gateway: Committed semantic event next sequence
 Gateway->>Gateway: Reduce contiguously
 Gateway-->>View: Confirmed projection
end
Core-->>Gateway: CoreEvent sequence N plus 3
Gateway->>Gateway: Detect gap, do not apply, mark stale
Gateway-->>View: Readable stale view, disable changes
Gateway->>Core: Request exact Delta or Snapshot
Core-->>Gateway: Exact envelopes through M or Snapshot through S plus tail
Gateway->>Gateway: Validate, deduplicate, run same reducer
Gateway-->>View: Resynchronized generation

data.title: Typed Command Dispatch and Ordered Projection Recovery
